entries.title: A GitLab job allowed to fail no longer holds your merge
entries.body: When a GitLab job that your project allows to fail fails or is cancelled, GitLab still passes the pipeline, and now the app does too: the checks read passed, the merge card goes up and the merge goes through. The checks still name that job as allowed to fail, on the desktop and the phone.

picture.alt: A merge card whose checks read passed, with 2 passed and 1 allowed to fail beneath
